rationale: Round 2 has clarified and hardened the main split: labour, the state, and the works council still categorically reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still insist that meaningful capacity reduction remains necessary. There is some shared language on shared sacrifice and negotiation, but the core contested trade-offs remain unresolved and the exchange is now circling the same lines, so facilitation or reframing is needed rather than more open-ended repetition.
